INVENTED: INVENTED INPUTS. This file is the writer's format sample for the judge, written on invented volumes, constants, counts and times. It is not a reference for any registered world and none of its numbers belongs to FR-45. It carries every section and every criterion's pairs, so some (C2b against this world's own root, C7, C8 on every set) are there for their format only. A refusal world (W5) differs: its equilibrium and distance_at_horizon are null and its trajectory, balances' and heats' lists are empty.
